patterns.note: An extreme high-contrast color scheme is used, dominated by a single vibrant neon green background with all text and primary graphic elements rendered in black.
The layout is highly asymmetrical and sparse, with primary content aligned to the left and significant negative space, while navigation elements are positioned to the right.
Large, bold sans-serif typography is used for main content and headings, complemented by smaller, uppercase text enclosed in square brackets for section labels.

As the user scrolls, a large, pixelated or ASCII-art style background pattern slowly reveals and parallaxes upwards from the bottom of the screen, serving as a dynamic backdrop for large, revealing text elements.
Section titles are consistently presented as small, uppercase text enclosed in square brackets (e.g., '[ ABOUT ]'), creating clear and distinct content blocks.

technique_notes: A full-bleed, vibrant neon green is used as the page's primary background color, with all text and interactive elements rendered in black to create a stark, high-contrast visual experience.
Content is structured with generous negative space, favoring a left-aligned column for main information and a right-aligned column for navigation, contributing to an open and modern aesthetic.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely implemented with a canvas-based library, are used to reveal large, bold text elements and a complex, pixelated background pattern that appears to parallax or animate into view from the bottom as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, uppercase bracketed labels (~0.7x body).
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially in the hero and between major content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious and uncompromising use of a single, extremely vibrant neon green as the primary background color, paired exclusively with black text and elements. This high-contrast, almost brutalist color scheme, combined with the large, sparse typography and the unique scroll-triggered pixelated background animation, creates a memorable and energetic brand identity that feels both retro and futuristic.
